focal.title: Forge (hosted)
focal.tip: What the operator runs: the docker-compose stack.

nodes.title: Team member
nodes.name: Team member
nodes.purpose: A person in an org and its projects: files and reads issues, answers questions, approves releases, pairs boxes. Signs in by password, GitHub, Google or OIDC.

nodes.title: Platform operator
nodes.name: Platform operator
nodes.purpose: Runs the instance: an email on the ADMIN_EMAILS list reaches /api/admin and the /admin screens.

nodes.title: MCP client with a PAT
nodes.name: MCP client with a PAT
nodes.purpose: Any MCP client holding a forge_pat_* token (a developer's Claude Code, an agent account) calling /mcp. Cookies, JWTs and device tokens are refused there.

nodes.title: Web app (web-v2)
nodes.name: Web app (web-v2)
nodes.purpose: Next.js UI for issues, runs, sessions, conversations, settings and admin.

nodes.title: Runner daemon (forge-runner)
nodes.name: Runner daemon (forge-runner)
nodes.purpose: Rust daemon that executes work on a box the person paired.

nodes.title: Claude Code CLI
nodes.name: Claude Code CLI
nodes.purpose: The claude CLI the runner spawns with FORGE_PAT, FORGE_PROJECT_ID and FORGE_PROJECT_SLUG; it uses the box's own Claude login and calls Forge back over /mcp.

nodes.title: Core API and workers
nodes.name: Core API and workers
nodes.purpose: Backend over Postgres: issues, pipeline, devices, sessions, memory, integrations, MCP server and WebSocket rooms.

nodes.title: Postgres + pgvector
nodes.name: Postgres + pgvector
nodes.purpose: System of record, job queue and vector index.

nodes.title: Upload disk
nodes.name: Upload disk
nodes.purpose: Issue, comment, session and conversation attachments.

nodes.title: GitHub
nodes.name: GitHub
nodes.purpose: GitHub login (OAuth) and the GitHub App per connection: repos, pull requests, releases, installation tokens for runner git; webhooks in signed x-hub-signature-256. Runner binaries are downloaded from GitHub releases.

nodes.title: Google (OIDC, Sheets)
nodes.name: Google (OIDC, Sheets)
nodes.purpose: Google OIDC sign-in (platform) and Google Sheets read/write per connection with a service account.

nodes.title: SSO identity provider
nodes.name: SSO identity provider
nodes.purpose: A generic OIDC identity provider the operator configures (OIDC_ISSUER_URL) for SSO.

nodes.title: SMTP relay
nodes.name: SMTP relay
nodes.purpose: Mail relay for verification and invitation emails.

nodes.title: Sentry
nodes.name: Sentry
nodes.purpose: Error reporting from core and the browser (scrubbed by scrubSentryEvent), and, per connection, Sentry issue intake by pull and signed webhook.
nodes.owner: Sentry (the operator's and each project's org)

nodes.title: Coolify
nodes.name: Coolify
nodes.purpose: Deploy host per connection: dispatch, confirm and health-gate deploys through pg-boss forge.integrations jobs; deploy logs fetched and scrubbed.

nodes.title: Rocket.Chat
nodes.name: Rocket.Chat
nodes.purpose: Chat per connection: core opens a DDP websocket for inbound messages and posts questions, comment mirrors and replies over REST.

nodes.title: Postman
nodes.name: Postman
nodes.purpose: Postman per connection: a key test from core, and an MCP endpoint handed to agent sessions.

nodes.title: Epodsystem
nodes.name: Epodsystem
nodes.purpose: Epodsystem per connection: GraphQL from core and an MCP endpoint handed to agent sessions.

nodes.title: Anthropic API
nodes.name: Anthropic API
nodes.purpose: Anthropic Messages API for the in-app assistant when it is the chosen chat provider.

nodes.title: LLM gateway (LiteLLM)
nodes.name: LLM gateway (LiteLLM)
nodes.purpose: OpenAI-compatible gateway (LiteLLM): assistant chat, the fast model for memory extraction, consolidation, rerank and session titles, and vision for images.

nodes.title: Embeddings provider
nodes.name: Embeddings provider
nodes.purpose: OpenAI-shape /v1/embeddings endpoint: memory chunks, knowledge entries, issue titles and search queries.

nodes.title: Project webhook receivers
nodes.name: Project webhook receivers
nodes.purpose: Each project's configured URLs: Forge POSTs events signed x-forge-signature-256 through the webhook-delivery queue.
